from shipments import load_shipments, ROWS
from tally import ShipmentLedger


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_shipments())
    ledger = ShipmentLedger(rows[:1])
    ledger.add(rows[1])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_copy_is_safe():
    rows = list(load_shipments())
    ledger = ShipmentLedger(rows[:2])
    ledger.shipments().append(rows[2])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]

from shipments import load_shipments, ROWS
from tally import ShipmentLedger


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_shipments())
    ledger = ShipmentLedger(rows[:1])
    ledger.add(rows[1])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_add_to_empty():
    rows = list(load_shipments())
    ledger = ShipmentLedger()
    for x in rows:
        ledger.add(x)
    assert ledger.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS) and len(ledger.shipments()) == len(ROWS)


def test_copy_is_safe():
    rows = list(load_shipments())
    ledger = ShipmentLedger(rows[:2])
    ledger.shipments().append(rows[2])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_initial_total():
    assert ShipmentLedger(load_shipments()).total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)
